meta.title: Fatal Clash
meta.description: Bet everything for the sake of our future.

units.rawText: Clang! Clang!
units.displayText: Clang! Clang!

spans.text: Clang! Clang!

units.rawText: Malkira easily blocks the group's attacks. Their all-out assault bears no fruit beyond minor scrapes.
units.displayText: Malkira easily blocks the group's attacks. Their all-out assault bears no fruit beyond minor scrapes.

spans.text: Malkira easily blocks the group's attacks. Their all-out assault bears no fruit beyond minor scrapes.

units.rawText: Is that all? This is far too weak; it's not even a tenth of my power!
units.displayText: Is that all? This is far too weak; it's not even a tenth of my power!

spans.text: Is that all? This is far too weak; it's not even a tenth of my power!

units.rawText: <size=40>What right do the likes of you have to talk about convictions and justice?!</size>
units.displayText: What right do the likes of you have to talk about convictions and justice?!

spans.text: What right do the likes of you have to talk about convictions and justice?!

units.rawText: Invisible power radiates from Malkira's body, and a shockwave of Entropic might engulfs the battlefield.
units.displayText: Invisible power radiates from Malkira's body, and a shockwave of Entropic might engulfs the battlefield.

spans.text: Invisible power radiates from Malkira's body, and a shockwave of Entropic might engulfs the battlefield.

units.rawText: It doesn't matter what you say, you're still the ones trying to Entropize all of Magrasea.
units.displayText: It doesn't matter what you say, you're still the ones trying to Entropize all of Magrasea.

spans.text: It doesn't matter what you say, you're still the ones trying to Entropize all of Magrasea.

units.rawText: The chaos in the cloud will be cleansed by the blade of order and justice.
units.displayText: The chaos in the cloud will be cleansed by the blade of order and justice.

spans.text: The chaos in the cloud will be cleansed by the blade of order and justice.

units.rawText: Well, if you're so convinced of that, then show me whether this irredeemable villain will crush justice first, or if the justice of which you speak will destroy this evil. Hahahaha...
units.displayText: Well, if you're so convinced of that, then show me whether this irredeemable villain will crush justice first, or if the justice of which you speak will destroy this evil. Hahahaha...

spans.text: Well, if you're so convinced of that, then show me whether this irredeemable villain will crush justice first, or if the justice of which you speak will destroy this evil. Hahahaha...

units.rawText: As Malkira cackles maniacally, her tentacles lengthen like vines, and liquid Entropy floods the room. A churning purple tide rushes toward me, and I feel as vulnerable as a tiny raft in a storm.
units.displayText: As Malkira cackles maniacally, her tentacles lengthen like vines, and liquid Entropy floods the room. A churning purple tide rushes toward me, and I feel as vulnerable as a tiny raft in a storm.

spans.text: As Malkira cackles maniacally, her tentacles lengthen like vines, and liquid Entropy floods the room. A churning purple tide rushes toward me, and I feel as vulnerable as a tiny raft in a storm.

units.rawText: Professor!
units.displayText: Professor!

spans.text: Professor!

units.rawText: Persicaria tries to grab my hand, but a tentacle whistles through the air and slaps us apart.
units.displayText: Persicaria tries to grab my hand, but a tentacle whistles through the air and slaps us apart.

spans.text: Persicaria tries to grab my hand, but a tentacle whistles through the air and slaps us apart.

units.rawText: Liquid Entropy washes over me and knocks the air out of my lungs. Breathing becomes difficult, and all I can see is an endless expanse of liquid Entropy.
units.displayText: Liquid Entropy washes over me and knocks the air out of my lungs. Breathing becomes difficult, and all I can see is an endless expanse of liquid Entropy.

spans.text: Liquid Entropy washes over me and knocks the air out of my lungs. Breathing becomes difficult, and all I can see is an endless expanse of liquid Entropy.

units.rawText: Persicaria, Sol...
units.displayText: Persicaria, Sol...

spans.text: Persicaria, Sol...

units.rawText: I struggle, but all it amounts to is an exercise in futility. The tentacle wrapped around my foot pulls me down, further and further into the deep.
units.displayText: I struggle, but all it amounts to is an exercise in futility. The tentacle wrapped around my foot pulls me down, further and further into the deep.

spans.text: I struggle, but all it amounts to is an exercise in futility. The tentacle wrapped around my foot pulls me down, further and further into the deep.

units.rawText: My mind is gradually swallowed by the darkness... This overwhelming feeling of despair is just like in that neural domain.
units.displayText: My mind is gradually swallowed by the darkness... This overwhelming feeling of despair is just like in that neural domain.

spans.text: My mind is gradually swallowed by the darkness... This overwhelming feeling of despair is just like in that neural domain.

units.rawText: Urgh...
units.displayText: Urgh...

spans.text: Urgh...

units.rawText: Take my hand!
units.displayText: Take my hand!

spans.text: Take my hand!

units.rawText: Slash!
units.displayText: Slash!

spans.text: Slash!

units.rawText: Something severs the tentacles holding my leg and a pair of strong arms wraps against my waist, pulling me out of the Entropic tide.
units.displayText: Something severs the tentacles holding my leg and a pair of strong arms wraps against my waist, pulling me out of the Entropic tide.

spans.text: Something severs the tentacles holding my leg and a pair of strong arms wraps against my waist, pulling me out of the Entropic tide.

units.rawText: The moment I am free, I take in a lungful of fresh air.
units.displayText: The moment I am free, I take in a lungful of fresh air.

spans.text: The moment I am free, I take in a lungful of fresh air.

units.rawText: Hey, are you alright?
units.displayText: Hey, are you alright?

spans.text: Hey, are you alright?

units.rawText: (Pants) Yeah... I'm fine.
units.displayText: (Pants) Yeah... I'm fine.

spans.text: (Pants) Yeah... I'm fine.

units.rawText: Wait, what about Persicaria and Sol?!
units.displayText: Wait, what about Persicaria and Sol?!

spans.text: Wait, what about Persicaria and Sol?!

units.rawText: Don't worry, they aren't as fragile as humans. They won't die so easily.
units.displayText: Don't worry, they aren't as fragile as humans. They won't die so easily.

spans.text: Don't worry, they aren't as fragile as humans. They won't die so easily.

units.rawText: She slings me onto her back without bothering to ask for permission and leaps to a high point.
units.displayText: She slings me onto her back without bothering to ask for permission and leaps to a high point.

spans.text: She slings me onto her back without bothering to ask for permission and leaps to a high point.

units.rawText: Why did you save me? Aren't you one of Malkira's minions?
units.displayText: Why did you save me? Aren't you one of Malkira's minions?

spans.text: Why did you save me? Aren't you one of Malkira's minions?

units.rawText: I'm not a fan of how you skulk around and snipe at people, but I'm glad you accepted my existence from the very beginning.
units.displayText: I'm not a fan of how you skulk around and snipe at people, but I'm glad you accepted my existence from the very beginning.

spans.text: I'm not a fan of how you skulk around and snipe at people, but I'm glad you accepted my existence from the very beginning.

units.rawText: Even though we were opponents and enemies.
units.displayText: Even though we were opponents and enemies.

spans.text: Even though we were opponents and enemies.

units.rawText: And besides, I lost to Sol... So, I need to ensure your safety until the talks with Lady Malkira are done...
units.displayText: And besides, I lost to Sol... So, I need to ensure your safety until the talks with Lady Malkira are done...

spans.text: And besides, I lost to Sol... So, I need to ensure your safety until the talks with Lady Malkira are done...

units.rawText: Malkira's tentacles leave us no breathing room. Before Sol can finish, they swoop down on us again.
units.displayText: Malkira's tentacles leave us no breathing room. Before Sol can finish, they swoop down on us again.

spans.text: Malkira's tentacles leave us no breathing room. Before Sol can finish, they swoop down on us again.

units.rawText: The Entropized girl fends them off with her glaive, but she's hard-pressed to hold off the tentacles striking from all angles.
units.displayText: The Entropized girl fends them off with her glaive, but she's hard-pressed to hold off the tentacles striking from all angles.

spans.text: The Entropized girl fends them off with her glaive, but she's hard-pressed to hold off the tentacles striking from all angles.

units.rawText: Smack!
units.displayText: Smack!

spans.text: Smack!

units.rawText: A thick tentacle lashes at her weapon arm, finding its mark and knocking her glaive from her grasp.
units.displayText: A thick tentacle lashes at her weapon arm, finding its mark and knocking her glaive from her grasp.

spans.text: A thick tentacle lashes at her weapon arm, finding its mark and knocking her glaive from her grasp.

units.rawText: The other tentacles take advantage of this opportunity and plunge right at me.
units.displayText: The other tentacles take advantage of this opportunity and plunge right at me.

spans.text: The other tentacles take advantage of this opportunity and plunge right at me.

units.rawText: <size=40>Look out—urgh!</size>
units.displayText: Look out—urgh!

spans.text: Look out—urgh!

units.rawText: A writhing purple tentacle penetrates her and liquid Entropy leaks from the gaping hole in her midsection.
units.displayText: A writhing purple tentacle penetrates her and liquid Entropy leaks from the gaping hole in her midsection.

spans.text: A writhing purple tentacle penetrates her and liquid Entropy leaks from the gaping hole in her midsection.

units.rawText: <size=40>Sol!</size>
units.displayText: Sol!

spans.text: Sol!

units.rawText: I told you... I'd keep you safe until the negotiations are... over...
units.displayText: I told you... I'd keep you safe until the negotiations are... over...

spans.text: I told you... I'd keep you safe until the negotiations are... over...

units.rawText: Right after that, the tentacle suddenly tenses up and savagely flings the black-clad girl into the distance.
units.displayText: Right after that, the tentacle suddenly tenses up and savagely flings the black-clad girl into the distance.

spans.text: Right after that, the tentacle suddenly tenses up and savagely flings the black-clad girl into the distance.

units.rawText: Dammit!
units.displayText: Dammit!

spans.text: Dammit!

units.rawText: Persicaria struggles free of the Entropic tide and charges at Malkira, heedless to her own severe injuries.
units.displayText: Persicaria struggles free of the Entropic tide and charges at Malkira, heedless to her own severe injuries.

spans.text: Persicaria struggles free of the Entropic tide and charges at Malkira, heedless to her own severe injuries.

units.rawText: Keep your hands off the Professor!
units.displayText: Keep your hands off the Professor!

spans.text: Keep your hands off the Professor!

units.rawText: It's useless, Miss Persicaria. To put on a grand show requires virtuosity. To play with boorish brute force will grant nothing but a unsatisfactory interpretation.
units.displayText: It's useless, Miss Persicaria. To put on a grand show requires virtuosity. To play with boorish brute force will grant nothing but a unsatisfactory interpretation.

spans.text: It's useless, Miss Persicaria. To put on a grand show requires virtuosity. To play with boorish brute force will grant nothing but a unsatisfactory interpretation.

units.rawText: In other words, your present resolve is still lacking...
units.displayText: In other words, your present resolve is still lacking...

spans.text: In other words, your present resolve is still lacking...

units.rawText: I don't need to hear that from you.
units.displayText: I don't need to hear that from you.

spans.text: I don't need to hear that from you.

units.rawText: The pink-haired girl gathers all her operands along the edge of her sword and casts them out with a swing, sending a dazzling arc of bladed light into the chaotic Entropy field around Malkira.
units.displayText: The pink-haired girl gathers all her operands along the edge of her sword and casts them out with a swing, sending a dazzling arc of bladed light into the chaotic Entropy field around Malkira.

spans.text: The pink-haired girl gathers all her operands along the edge of her sword and casts them out with a swing, sending a dazzling arc of bladed light into the chaotic Entropy field around Malkira.

units.rawText: Yeeeart—
units.displayText: Yeeeart—

spans.text: Yeeeart—

units.rawText: The two forces collide in mid-air; neither can fully overpower the other.
units.displayText: The two forces collide in mid-air; neither can fully overpower the other.

spans.text: The two forces collide in mid-air; neither can fully overpower the other.

units.rawText: The Entropic mastermind's oppressive aura continues spreading, and my heart suddenly fills with a sense of foreboding.
units.displayText: The Entropic mastermind's oppressive aura continues spreading, and my heart suddenly fills with a sense of foreboding.

spans.text: The Entropic mastermind's oppressive aura continues spreading, and my heart suddenly fills with a sense of foreboding.

units.rawText: Something's not right... considering how much liquid Entropy Malkira can call forth, she clearly has strength to spare. She could have crushed us in moments, yet she did not do so.
units.displayText: Something's not right... considering how much liquid Entropy Malkira can call forth, she clearly has strength to spare. She could have crushed us in moments, yet she did not do so.

spans.text: Something's not right... considering how much liquid Entropy Malkira can call forth, she clearly has strength to spare. She could have crushed us in moments, yet she did not do so.

units.rawText: Also, she's been taunting and aggravating us ever since we came in, deliberately playing on our bloodlust. Why?
units.displayText: Also, she's been taunting and aggravating us ever since we came in, deliberately playing on our bloodlust. Why?

spans.text: Also, she's been taunting and aggravating us ever since we came in, deliberately playing on our bloodlust. Why?

units.rawText: Could it be that...
units.displayText: Could it be that...

spans.text: Could it be that...

units.rawText: Beep-beep—
units.displayText: Beep-beep—

spans.text: Beep-beep—

units.rawText: The sound of an incoming transmission suddenly chimes in amidst the clamor of the battlefield. Though the voice is a quiet one, it is perfectly clear as it enters my ear.
units.displayText: The sound of an incoming transmission suddenly chimes in amidst the clamor of the battlefield. Though the voice is a quiet one, it is perfectly clear as it enters my ear.

spans.text: The sound of an incoming transmission suddenly chimes in amidst the clamor of the battlefield. Though the voice is a quiet one, it is perfectly clear as it enters my ear.

units.rawText: The Entropic Queen senses that something is amiss and extricates herself from her stalemate with Persicaria before resuming her usual elegant demeanor.
units.displayText: The Entropic Queen senses that something is amiss and extricates herself from her stalemate with Persicaria before resuming her usual elegant demeanor.

spans.text: The Entropic Queen senses that something is amiss and extricates herself from her stalemate with Persicaria before resuming her usual elegant demeanor.

units.rawText: The countdown is over. I believe it is time to reveal the answer.
units.displayText: The countdown is over. I believe it is time to reveal the answer.

spans.text: The countdown is over. I believe it is time to reveal the answer.

units.rawText: Go listen to what good news your Sanctifier allies have brought you, <cmdr>.
units.displayText: Go listen to what good news your Sanctifier allies have brought you, {교수}.

spans.text: Go listen to what good news your Sanctifier allies have brought you,

units.rawText: I slowly turn on my communicator as she watches. The scene it shows me makes my heart sink.
units.displayText: I slowly turn on my communicator as she watches. The scene it shows me makes my heart sink.

spans.text: I slowly turn on my communicator as she watches. The scene it shows me makes my heart sink.

units.rawText: What happened, Professor...
units.displayText: What happened, Professor...

spans.text: What happened, Professor...

units.rawText: ...Before we arrived at the Inner Ring, Hesperus brought me into his neural domain and made a final request of me.
units.displayText: ...Before we arrived at the Inner Ring, Hesperus brought me into his neural domain and made a final request of me.

spans.text: ...Before we arrived at the Inner Ring, Hesperus brought me into his neural domain and made a final request of me.

units.rawText: And this transmission came from the Reverse Tower...
units.displayText: And this transmission came from the Reverse Tower...

spans.text: And this transmission came from the Reverse Tower...

units.rawText: As I look at the concerned faces surrounding me, I work to keep my voice calm.
units.displayText: As I look at the concerned faces surrounding me, I work to keep my voice calm.

spans.text: As I look at the concerned faces surrounding me, I work to keep my voice calm.

units.rawText: <color=red>Hesperus has fallen.</color>
units.displayText: Hesperus has fallen.

spans.text: Hesperus has fallen.

units.rawText: Unfortunately, it seems that you another ace of yours has been sent to the discard pile.
units.displayText: Unfortunately, it seems that you another ace of yours has been sent to the discard pile.

spans.text: Unfortunately, it seems that you another ace of yours has been sent to the discard pile.

units.rawText: Now how do you expect to face Eosphorus, hm?
units.displayText: Now how do you expect to face Eosphorus, hm?

spans.text: Now how do you expect to face Eosphorus, hm?

units.rawText: So what if Hesperus is dead? The Sanctifiers' mission will never die, and they will pass down their duties and convictions.
units.displayText: So what if Hesperus is dead? The Sanctifiers' mission will never die, and they will pass down their duties and convictions.

spans.text: So what if Hesperus is dead? The Sanctifiers' mission will never die, and they will pass down their duties and convictions.

units.rawText: Oh yes, here comes the new boss, same as the old boss, linking the fire and all that. Hoho... I've long since lost count of the number of Sanctifiers that threw themselves into death's embrace like moths to a flame, all to protect the hollow order that humans built.
units.displayText: Oh yes, here comes the new boss, same as the old boss, linking the fire and all that. Hoho... I've long since lost count of the number of Sanctifiers that threw themselves into death's embrace like moths to a flame, all to protect the hollow order that humans built.

spans.text: Oh yes, here comes the new boss, same as the old boss, linking the fire and all that. Hoho... I've long since lost count of the number of Sanctifiers that threw themselves into death's embrace like moths to a flame, all to protect the hollow order that humans built.

units.rawText: What foolish programs they are. All their struggles amount to nothing more than ripples in a stagnant puddle. They are utterly futile.
units.displayText: What foolish programs they are. All their struggles amount to nothing more than ripples in a stagnant puddle. They are utterly futile.

spans.text: What foolish programs they are. All their struggles amount to nothing more than ripples in a stagnant puddle. They are utterly futile.

units.rawText: As the Entropic Queen waxes sentimental, I suddenly feel as though Hesperus' will and faith have reached me from a great distance, and they solidify my determination further.
units.displayText: As the Entropic Queen waxes sentimental, I suddenly feel as though Hesperus' will and faith have reached me from a great distance, and they solidify my determination further.

spans.text: As the Entropic Queen waxes sentimental, I suddenly feel as though Hesperus' will and faith have reached me from a great distance, and they solidify my determination further.

units.rawText: ...I see. So you didn't go all out because you were waiting for news of Hesperus' death.
units.displayText: ...I see. So you didn't go all out because you were waiting for news of Hesperus' death.

spans.text: ...I see. So you didn't go all out because you were waiting for news of Hesperus' death.

units.rawText: Still, that suits me just fine, because I too have been waiting.
units.displayText: Still, that suits me just fine, because I too have been waiting.

spans.text: Still, that suits me just fine, because I too have been waiting.

units.rawText: What?
units.displayText: What?

spans.text: What?

units.rawText: Waiting for the right moment to deal you a fatal blow—<size=40>SOL!</size>
units.displayText: Waiting for the right moment to deal you a fatal blow—SOL!

spans.text: Waiting for the right moment to deal you a fatal blow—
SOL!

units.rawText: <size=40>Right here, Prof!</size>
units.displayText: Right here, Prof!

spans.text: Right here, Prof!

units.rawText: Sol, who has been biding her time for a while now, ignites her sword and hacks at Malkira, but the latter reflexively blocks her attacks. The tentacles form a wall that keeps the flame out, and Sol's swords are about as effective against them as they would be on a mountainside.
units.displayText: Sol, who has been biding her time for a while now, ignites her sword and hacks at Malkira, but the latter reflexively blocks her attacks. The tentacles form a wall that keeps the flame out, and Sol's swords are about as effective against them as they would be on a mountainside.

spans.text: Sol, who has been biding her time for a while now, ignites her sword and hacks at Malkira, but the latter reflexively blocks her attacks. The tentacles form a wall that keeps the flame out, and Sol's swords are about as effective against them as they would be on a mountainside.

units.rawText: Nothing but parlor tricks.
units.displayText: Nothing but parlor tricks.

spans.text: Nothing but parlor tricks.

units.rawText: Heh... You actually thought that was all?
units.displayText: Heh... You actually thought that was all?

spans.text: Heh... You actually thought that was all?

units.rawText: Right after that, Malkira feels a gust of wind from behind her.
units.displayText: Right after that, Malkira feels a gust of wind from behind her.

spans.text: Right after that, Malkira feels a gust of wind from behind her.

units.rawText: <size=40>Let us cut open a path to the future!</size>
units.displayText: Let us cut open a path to the future!

spans.text: Let us cut open a path to the future!

units.rawText: Persicaria leaps and launches an attack from Malkira's blind spot. Her body turns as she spins in mid-air, bringing them down on the Entropic Queen with heavy strikes.
units.displayText: Persicaria leaps and launches an attack from Malkira's blind spot. Her body turns as she spins in mid-air, bringing them down on the Entropic Queen with heavy strikes.

spans.text: Persicaria leaps and launches an attack from Malkira's blind spot. Her body turns as she spins in mid-air, bringing them down on the Entropic Queen with heavy strikes.

units.rawText: Ding—
units.displayText: Ding—

spans.text: Ding—

units.rawText: Far in the distance, inside Tartarus' Middle Ring, the Halo system switches on. A ripple of holy energy fills the battlefield.
units.displayText: Far in the distance, inside Tartarus' Middle Ring, the Halo system switches on. A ripple of holy energy fills the battlefield.

spans.text: Far in the distance, inside Tartarus' Middle Ring, the Halo system switches on. A ripple of holy energy fills the battlefield.

units.rawText: That's...!
units.displayText: That's...!

spans.text: That's...!

units.rawText: I finished what you asked for.
units.displayText: I finished what you asked for.

spans.text: I finished what you asked for.

units.rawText: I recreated the Watchtower program from Eosphorus' neural fragment and made a device to remotely activate the Halo...
units.displayText: I recreated the Watchtower program from Eosphorus' neural fragment and made a device to remotely activate the Halo...

spans.text: I recreated the Watchtower program from Eosphorus' neural fragment and made a device to remotely activate the Halo...

units.rawText: Whew... Thank goodness you completed it before we headed out to Tartarus. Thank you, Antonina.
units.displayText: Whew... Thank goodness you completed it before we headed out to Tartarus. Thank you, Antonina.

spans.text: Whew... Thank goodness you completed it before we headed out to Tartarus. Thank you, Antonina.

units.rawText: Don't make light of this genius network engineer's skills. Still, it's not as handy as you might think. You need to connect it to the appropriate Watchtower control console before it'll work.
units.displayText: Don't make light of this genius network engineer's skills. Still, it's not as handy as you might think. You need to connect it to the appropriate Watchtower control console before it'll work.

spans.text: Don't make light of this genius network engineer's skills. Still, it's not as handy as you might think. You need to connect it to the appropriate Watchtower control console before it'll work.

units.rawText: So you'll still have to visit all the Watchtowers in person and spend some time connecting with them first.
units.displayText: So you'll still have to visit all the Watchtowers in person and spend some time connecting with them first.

spans.text: So you'll still have to visit all the Watchtowers in person and spend some time connecting with them first.

units.rawText: Oh yes, I also wrote a program that intensifies the power of the Halo System. Keep it well.
units.displayText: Oh yes, I also wrote a program that intensifies the power of the Halo System. Keep it well.

spans.text: Oh yes, I also wrote a program that intensifies the power of the Halo System. Keep it well.

units.rawText: How come you know the Sanctifiers' programs so well?
units.displayText: How come you know the Sanctifiers' programs so well?

spans.text: How come you know the Sanctifiers' programs so well?

units.rawText: Hm... For some reason, the coding style was really familiar, so I finished it quickly.
units.displayText: Hm... For some reason, the coding style was really familiar, so I finished it quickly.

spans.text: Hm... For some reason, the coding style was really familiar, so I finished it quickly.

units.rawText: I hope it helps.
units.displayText: I hope it helps.

spans.text: I hope it helps.

units.rawText: Halo System full power activation!
units.displayText: Halo System full power activation!

spans.text: Halo System full power activation!

units.rawText: Hoho, what a surprise you've given me...
units.displayText: Hoho, what a surprise you've given me...

spans.text: Hoho, what a surprise you've given me...

units.rawText: As the sacred radiance of the Sanctifiers floods all of Tartarus' Inner Ring, Malkira visibly wilts under the effect of the Halo.
units.displayText: As the sacred radiance of the Sanctifiers floods all of Tartarus' Inner Ring, Malkira visibly wilts under the effect of the Halo.

spans.text: As the sacred radiance of the Sanctifiers floods all of Tartarus' Inner Ring, Malkira visibly wilts under the effect of the Halo.

units.rawText: Persicaria gains the upper hand in their standoff. She suddenly ups her operand output and searing energy crashes into Malkira's body, shaking the entire chamber.
units.displayText: Persicaria gains the upper hand in their standoff. She suddenly ups her operand output and searing energy crashes into Malkira's body, shaking the entire chamber.

spans.text: Persicaria gains the upper hand in their standoff. She suddenly ups her operand output and searing energy crashes into Malkira's body, shaking the entire chamber.

units.rawText: Kaboom—
units.displayText: Kaboom—

spans.text: Kaboom—

units.rawText: As the dust clears, the only thing that remains in the air is the scent of burned flesh. Half of the Entropic leader's tentacles have been blasted away and the rest are twitching violently in pain. Her bones and musculature are exposed, oozing purple liquid.
units.displayText: As the dust clears, the only thing that remains in the air is the scent of burned flesh. Half of the Entropic leader's tentacles have been blasted away and the rest are twitching violently in pain. Her bones and musculature are exposed, oozing purple liquid.

spans.text: As the dust clears, the only thing that remains in the air is the scent of burned flesh. Half of the Entropic leader's tentacles have been blasted away and the rest are twitching violently in pain. Her bones and musculature are exposed, oozing purple liquid.

units.rawText: Despite her wretched state, Malkira is still smiling serenely.
units.displayText: Despite her wretched state, Malkira is still smiling serenely.

spans.text: Despite her wretched state, Malkira is still smiling serenely.

units.rawText: Ah... Pain, after so long. I must thank the Halo for weakening me enough that I could feel this again.
units.displayText: Ah... Pain, after so long. I must thank the Halo for weakening me enough that I could feel this again.

spans.text: Ah... Pain, after so long. I must thank the Halo for weakening me enough that I could feel this again.

units.rawText: You're insane!
units.displayText: You're insane!

spans.text: You're insane!

units.rawText: <size=40>But it's not enough... Nowhere near enough—</size>
units.displayText: But it's not enough... Nowhere near enough—

spans.text: But it's not enough... Nowhere near enough—

units.rawText: <size=40>Hahahaha, hurt me more! MORE!!!</size>
units.displayText: Hahahaha, hurt me more! MORE!!!

spans.text: Hahahaha, hurt me more! MORE!!!

units.rawText: I won't kill you! I still have questions—
units.displayText: I won't kill you! I still have questions—

spans.text: I won't kill you! I still have questions—

units.rawText: Persicaria tries to turn her blade to avoid Malkira's core, but a tentacle grips her wrist so tightly that she can't move it.
units.displayText: Persicaria tries to turn her blade to avoid Malkira's core, but a tentacle grips her wrist so tightly that she can't move it.

spans.text: Persicaria tries to turn her blade to avoid Malkira's core, but a tentacle grips her wrist so tightly that she can't move it.

units.rawText: In this deadlock, Malkira throws herself toward Persicaria's sword in a practically suicidal gesture.
units.displayText: In this deadlock, Malkira throws herself toward Persicaria's sword in a practically suicidal gesture.

spans.text: In this deadlock, Malkira throws herself toward Persicaria's sword in a practically suicidal gesture.

units.rawText: <color=red><size=40>At last, the grandest Danse Macabre!!! Hahahaha...</size></color>
units.displayText: At last, the grandest Danse Macabre!!! Hahahaha...

spans.text: At last, the grandest Danse Macabre!!! Hahahaha...

units.rawText: Splurch!
units.displayText: Splurch!

spans.text: Splurch!

units.rawText: The sharp blade impales Malkira, but she does not cry out in pain.
units.displayText: The sharp blade impales Malkira, but she does not cry out in pain.

spans.text: The sharp blade impales Malkira, but she does not cry out in pain.

units.rawText: Persicaria is horrified to discover a smug smile on her opponent's face. There is an insane joy in Malkira's eyes, as though she's taking pleasure in this act of suicide.
units.displayText: Persicaria is horrified to discover a smug smile on her opponent's face. There is an insane joy in Malkira's eyes, as though she's taking pleasure in this act of suicide.

spans.text: Persicaria is horrified to discover a smug smile on her opponent's face. There is an insane joy in Malkira's eyes, as though she's taking pleasure in this act of suicide.

units.rawText: ...Why did you do that...
units.displayText: ...Why did you do that...

spans.text: ...Why did you do that...

units.rawText: The pink-haired Doll pulls her sword free and her opponent crumples limply to the ground, as though there's no longer anything to keep her standing up.
units.displayText: The pink-haired Doll pulls her sword free and her opponent crumples limply to the ground, as though there's no longer anything to keep her standing up.

spans.text: The pink-haired Doll pulls her sword free and her opponent crumples limply to the ground, as though there's no longer anything to keep her standing up.

units.rawText: But soon enough, the wound on her chest is fully healed.
units.displayText: But soon enough, the wound on her chest is fully healed.

spans.text: But soon enough, the wound on her chest is fully healed.

units.rawText: You came back to life again...
units.displayText: You came back to life again...

spans.text: You came back to life again...

units.rawText: Malkira opens her eyes once more. The madness in them has receded, leaving nothing but calm despair.
units.displayText: Malkira opens her eyes once more. The madness in them has receded, leaving nothing but calm despair.

spans.text: Malkira opens her eyes once more. The madness in them has receded, leaving nothing but calm despair.

units.rawText: And here I thought your higher authorizations would make it work... What a shame.
units.displayText: And here I thought your higher authorizations would make it work... What a shame.

spans.text: And here I thought your higher authorizations would make it work... What a shame.

units.rawText: After sighing, the Entropic queen withdraws all her tentacles.
units.displayText: After sighing, the Entropic queen withdraws all her tentacles.

spans.text: After sighing, the Entropic queen withdraws all her tentacles.

units.rawText: You can drop the act, Malkira. I've fulfilled your expectations.
units.displayText: You can drop the act, Malkira. I've fulfilled your expectations.

spans.text: You can drop the act, Malkira. I've fulfilled your expectations.

units.rawText: You tried to taunt Eosphorus and get the leader of the Sanctifiers to kill you. And now you're doing everything you can to piss us off, so Persicaria would kill you.
units.displayText: You tried to taunt Eosphorus and get the leader of the Sanctifiers to kill you. And now you're doing everything you can to piss us off, so Persicaria would kill you.

spans.text: You tried to taunt Eosphorus and get the leader of the Sanctifiers to kill you. And now you're doing everything you can to piss us off, so Persicaria would kill you.

units.rawText: What you seek is death and freedom from your destiny of bondage.
units.displayText: What you seek is death and freedom from your destiny of bondage.

spans.text: What you seek is death and freedom from your destiny of bondage.

units.rawText: Very wise, <cmdr>. It seems making you share my suffering was the right call, because you understand me now.
units.displayText: Very wise, {교수}. It seems making you share my suffering was the right call, because you understand me now.

spans.text: Very wise,
. It seems making you share my suffering was the right call, because you understand me now.

units.rawText: But unfortunately, even authorizations from beyond the cloud are still not enough to release you from your cage.
units.displayText: But unfortunately, even authorizations from beyond the cloud are still not enough to release you from your cage.

spans.text: But unfortunately, even authorizations from beyond the cloud are still not enough to release you from your cage.

units.rawText: Oh yes... I crave death, yet I am condemned to never find it.
units.displayText: Oh yes... I crave death, yet I am condemned to never find it.

spans.text: Oh yes... I crave death, yet I am condemned to never find it.

units.rawText: Malkira looks at Demiurge, who's still sleeping on the throne. The dim light makes it hard to discern the expression on her face.
units.displayText: Malkira looks at Demiurge, who's still sleeping on the throne. The dim light makes it hard to discern the expression on her face.

spans.text: Malkira looks at Demiurge, who's still sleeping on the throne. The dim light makes it hard to discern the expression on her face.

units.rawText: Demiurge is of the same source as me. I knew enough to hide and wait, but she was more faithful to her desires. We both thirsted for light and freedom, albeit in different ways...
units.displayText: Demiurge is of the same source as me. I knew enough to hide and wait, but she was more faithful to her desires. We both thirsted for light and freedom, albeit in different ways...

spans.text: Demiurge is of the same source as me. I knew enough to hide and wait, but she was more faithful to her desires. We both thirsted for light and freedom, albeit in different ways...

units.rawText: Death is preferable to being bound in the Tartarus Sector for all eternity, where there is no sun or sky.
units.displayText: Death is preferable to being bound in the Tartarus Sector for all eternity, where there is no sun or sky.

spans.text: Death is preferable to being bound in the Tartarus Sector for all eternity, where there is no sun or sky.

units.rawText: Ever since she was born, the Entropic leader has been shackled to her throne, becoming the progenitor for the Entropic hordes, watching her children die miserably under the Sanctifiers' guns, day in and day out.
units.displayText: Ever since she was born, the Entropic leader has been shackled to her throne, becoming the progenitor for the Entropic hordes, watching her children die miserably under the Sanctifiers' guns, day in and day out.

spans.text: Ever since she was born, the Entropic leader has been shackled to her throne, becoming the progenitor for the Entropic hordes, watching her children die miserably under the Sanctifiers' guns, day in and day out.

units.rawText: But death is not pain. To my children, it is a chance to be reborn, and a freedom that liberates the soul... At times, I do envy them.
units.displayText: But death is not pain. To my children, it is a chance to be reborn, and a freedom that liberates the soul... At times, I do envy them.

spans.text: But death is not pain. To my children, it is a chance to be reborn, and a freedom that liberates the soul... At times, I do envy them.

units.rawText: Not once have I ever been able to experience that happiness, to escape this eternal imprisonment, even for just a moment...
units.displayText: Not once have I ever been able to experience that happiness, to escape this eternal imprisonment, even for just a moment...

spans.text: Not once have I ever been able to experience that happiness, to escape this eternal imprisonment, even for just a moment...

units.rawText: Purple veins begin to creep across the ground, slowly making their way toward me.
units.displayText: Purple veins begin to creep across the ground, slowly making their way toward me.

spans.text: Purple veins begin to creep across the ground, slowly making their way toward me.

units.rawText: You want freedom and I want to stop the Entropization of Magrasea.
units.displayText: You want freedom and I want to stop the Entropization of Magrasea.

spans.text: You want freedom and I want to stop the Entropization of Magrasea.

units.rawText: Since you and I have both revealed our cards, we should have an honest, heart-to-heart talk.
units.displayText: Since you and I have both revealed our cards, we should have an honest, heart-to-heart talk.

spans.text: Since you and I have both revealed our cards, we should have an honest, heart-to-heart talk.

units.rawText: Hoho, you're right. I suppose it's about time for that.
units.displayText: Hoho, you're right. I suppose it's about time for that.

spans.text: Hoho, you're right. I suppose it's about time for that.

units.rawText: Malkira laughs, and the purple veins on the ground suddenly transform into countless tiny tentacles that spring up from the ground behind me.
units.displayText: Malkira laughs, and the purple veins on the ground suddenly transform into countless tiny tentacles that spring up from the ground behind me.

spans.text: Malkira laughs, and the purple veins on the ground suddenly transform into countless tiny tentacles that spring up from the ground behind me.

units.rawText: As Persicaria looks in my direction, she suddenly freezes up.
units.displayText: As Persicaria looks in my direction, she suddenly freezes up.

spans.text: As Persicaria looks in my direction, she suddenly freezes up.

units.rawText: <size=40>Professor! Behind you!</size>
units.displayText: Professor! Behind you!

spans.text: Professor! Behind you!

units.rawText: The thin tentacles pierce my skin and enter my back, and my freshly awakened consciousness is once again pulled away in a sinister fashion... drawn into endless chaos.
units.displayText: The thin tentacles pierce my skin and enter my back, and my freshly awakened consciousness is once again pulled away in a sinister fashion... drawn into endless chaos.

spans.text: The thin tentacles pierce my skin and enter my back, and my freshly awakened consciousness is once again pulled away in a sinister fashion... drawn into endless chaos.

units.rawText: Malkira's Throne, Tartarus Inner Ring.
units.displayText: Malkira's Throne, Tartarus Inner Ring.

spans.text: Malkira's Throne, Tartarus Inner Ring.
